about: Pass 5 file ownership. Each lane edits only files it owns; Lane 0 files are shared helpers and generated files that lanes call but never edit. A new file belongs to the first rule its path matches (lanes: prefer your lane's prefixes, e.g. a lane-specific test helper file <lane>_*.go). examples/<kind>/<type>/ belongs to the lane of the type. A cross-lane need is a TODO line in the lane report, never an edit.

pass51.about: Pass 5.1 file ownership (lanes H, P, D, R, S; Z = integration and generated files). Each lane edits only files it owns; `files` lists every existing file, a new file belongs to the first `rules` entry it matches (prefer your lane's prefix: h_/p_/d_/r_/s_*.go), anything unmatched is Z. A cross-lane need is a TODO line with the exact change in reference/_gen/pass51/lane-<X>.md, never an edit. Check before staging: p51_ownership.py --check <lane> <listing>.

pass53.about: Pass 5.3 file ownership (lanes A, R, S, K, B, I; 0 = Lane 0 helpers and fieldcov, frozen during the lanes; Z = integration and generated files). Each lane edits only files it owns; `files` lists every existing file, a new file belongs to the first `rules` entry it matches (prefer your lane's prefix: a_/r_/s_/k_/b_/i_*.go), anything unmatched is Z. Inventory: new items go in reference/_gen/fragments/pass53-<lane>.json, new outputs in fragments/outputs/P53<lane>.json; a change to an existing fragment entry is a TODO for Z. Field coverage: manual entries in reference/_gen/fieldmap.d/<lane>.json. A cross-lane need is a TODO line with the exact change in reference/_gen/pass53/lane-<X>.md, never an edit. Check before handing over: p53_ownership.py --check <lane> <listing>.
